dedupe_keys.name: sources du chiffre d affaires sncf depuis 1955

description: Sources du chiffre d'affaires SNCF depuis 1955 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Trajectoire des revenus SNCF avec plusieurs étapes (1955, 1994, 1999,2004, 2009 et 2014) depuis 1955 en milliards d'euros actualisés à 2014 (euros constants). NB: les normes comptables appliquées ici sont les normes françaises avant 2007 et IFRS ensuite. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are Revenus, Chiffre d'affaire, Groupe SNCF, Direction Stratégie Finances. The portal shows 2017-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
